actions.action: Scratch several twigs across the shrub with a fingernail to check for green tissue
Check soil moisture weekly by pushing a finger 2-3 inches into the soil near the base
Water deeply if the soil is dry
Reassess in late May or early June by scratching stems and looking for new leaves
If stems are still brown and no new leaves, have a local nursery or extension office look at it
